messages.content: Help me asynchronously attempt to acquire a permit from a Redisson expirable semaphore with a wait time of 5 seconds, a lease time of 2 minutes, and using the TimeUnit of SECONDS?

function.name: RedissonPermitExpirableSemaphore_tryAcquireAsync
function.description: Attempts to acquire a permit from the semaphore asynchronously, with the ability to specify the wait time, lease time, and time unit. Returns a future that will be completed with the permit ID if acquired. Note that the provided function is in Java 8 SDK syntax.

waitTime.description: The maximum time to wait for a permit to become available. This is Java long type parameter in string representation.

leaseTime.description: The time to lease the permit once acquired. This is Java long type parameter in string representation.

unit.description: The time unit for both waitTime and leaseTime. This is Java String type parameter in string representation.

message.reasoning: The user wants to call the tool RedissonPermitExpirableSemaphore_tryAcquireAsync with waitTime=5, leaseTime=2, unit=SECONDS. The user wants to acquire a permit asynchronously. The tool expects waitTime and leaseTime as strings representing Java long values. The user wants to use 5 seconds wait time, 2 minutes lease time, but the tool expects unit for both waitTime and leaseTime. The user says "using the TimeUnit of SECONDS". That means we should pass unit=SECONDS. But the leaseTime is 2 minutes, but the unit is SECONDS. So we need to convert 2 minutes into seconds? The user says "lease time of 2 minutes" but the tool expects unit=SECONDS. So we can interpret that the user wants to pass leaseTime=120 (seconds). The user says "using the TimeUnit of SECONDS". So we pass unit=SECONDS. The user wants to pass waitTime=5, leaseTime=120, unit=SECONDS. The tool expects waitTime and leaseTime as strings. So we pass waitTime="5", leaseTime="120", unit="SECONDS". That matches the tool signature. The user wants to attempt to acquire a permit asynchronously. So we call the tool with those arguments.
